name: sqli-rowfilter
description: Role row filters. A row filter stored in the old JSON format was loaded with gson and its sql used as is, and SqlFrag turned an unknown {...} token into nothing, so a JSON filter passed the check when saved. Now a filter starting with { is refused on save (console, bundle copy, XLS settings) and on read, and an unknown {...} token is an error (2026-10-31). Uses the sqli-filter survey and its own role, kept. The last probe clears the filter it set, so the role is left with no filter.
